decision: v4 source review reopened: observation-only failure recovery blocker
reproduction: Admit window1000-1900. Diagnostic-only logger raises at successful forecast1300. Restore healthy logger; score official outcome1900.
cause: Slot emitted marker is committed only after logging returns. A failed logging attempt leaves slot eligible for future score receipt, which gets mislabeled as late first pass. A logging handler that writes then raises additionally allows duplicate slot output.
required: Commit slot attempt before diagnostic side effects and prevent later score from being presented as first slot observation; regression for raising before and after log append, including more than one simultaneous forecast.
behavior: No learner/practice decision change was observed; issue concerns observation attribution and at-most-once output.
